### Also covered by
Mac Lane §III.4, Exercise 2 (book p. 72, PDF p. 81), item `maclane:III.4:ex2`: the J-indexed cartesian product with its projections is the categorical product in **Set** — the same mathematical obligation as this issue's indexed products in Sets (the in-tree vocabulary is `iprod`/`HasIndexedProducts`, Structure/Limit/Product.v, with no Sets instance yet). NEW aspect added by III.4: the exercise also asks for the analogous description in **Top**, which is gated on the category of topological spaces (#259) and should be recorded as an optional extension once Top lands.
